chapter: Southern Illinois roadhouse and St. Louis
title: Ragtime versus Jazz as names
summary: Joe first thought of his music as jazz in Los Angeles; before that it was always ragtime.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: When do you remember... You say that in the early days, the bands were called Ragtime bands and... Where do you first remember thinking that what you were playing was Jazz? Or did you ever think that what you were playing was Jazz?
i can't remember... The first time I recall what we were playing was Jazz was when I came to Los Angeles, to tell you the truth.
Oh, a long time after that.

Yes. It was always called Ragtime. Jazz just kind of fell in there someplace, I guess. All of those... The type of music, like I said, was...that those professors in New Orleans played in those Red-Light District homes (they called them professors), they called it Ragtime music. That's all.
